scope: Generated Unity benchmark fallback only; authored danchi replacement remains authoritative.

manufacture_installation.assembly: Ordinary occupied-apartment curtain dressing behind an aluminium sliding sash, representative of late-1990s to circa-2000 Japanese public/suburban housing interiors visible from outdoors.

components.construction: extruded aluminium rail with opaque factory coating
components.mounting: fixed to interior lintel/header immediately above curtain leaves; fasteners are occluded at benchmark exterior distance
components.geometry_vs_material: Track extrusion is geometry; coating roughness and pigment are material response. No painted highlight line.

components.construction: woven synthetic/cotton-blend domestic curtain, gathered on track
components.mounting: suspended from track; LOD0 carries physical vertical pleat relief
components.geometry_vs_material: Macro pleats and open gap are geometry; yarn/weave is normal/albedo microstructure.

components.construction: paired woven domestic curtain leaf; same cloth family as the left leaf but independently gathered
components.geometry_vs_material: Opening asymmetry comes from physical leaf widths/positions, never from a painted dark stripe.

components.construction: non-emissive room/curtain-depth backing already provided by facade optics
components.mounting: visual depth stop only; does not replace glazing or curtain geometry
components.geometry_vs_material: Backing supplies room-value depth; it must not carry fake window reflections or baked highlights.

interfaces_gaps_seals.note: Curtain geometry is physically separated from glazing and room backing to prevent interpenetration and flat layered-card appearance.

manufacture_installation.orientation: All visible cloth and track faces are oriented toward the exterior window and inherit the sash/facade coordinate frame.

exposure_aging.environment: Interior daytime surface behind glazing; low direct weather exposure, repeated summer UV through glass, household dust and handling.
cause_based_changes: slight UV desaturation toward exposed folds over years
excluded: painted-in sun highlights or window reflections

albedo_linear_rgb.rule: Only pigment/yarn variation is encoded. No folds, shadows, highlights or sky reflection are painted into albedo.

materials_finish.wetness: Interior benchmark state is dry. No wetness darkening or gloss boost is allowed.
materials_finish.uv_aging: Very mild desaturation is permissible as a future causal layer, but is not baked as directional lighting.
materials_finish.angular_fresnel_response: Textile remains low-gloss; dielectric Fresnel is weak frontally and increases only physically toward grazing angles. Glazing in front remains the dominant specular layer.

materials_finish.surface_class: opaque dielectric coating over aluminium extrusion
materials_finish.microstructure: Sub-millimetre coating texture is below benchmark need; track silhouette and section are geometry.
materials_finish.uv_aging: Possible slight yellowing/chalking after long exposure through glazing; not directionally painted.
materials_finish.angular_fresnel_response: Coating gives modest dielectric edge response; exposed-metal metallic values are prohibited because the visible surface is coating.

approved_manufactured_repetition: same sash dimensions across repeated housing bays
prohibited_clone_repetition: all thirty apartments showing the same curtain opening
same cloth family and same left/right gathering dimensions repeated conspicuously
identical room-value rectangle in every visible bay

deterministic_layout_rules.reason: Occupant behavior varies while mass-produced exterior construction remains regular.

lod0.cloth: dedicated physically pleated mesh with metre-derived UV scale

lod1.cloth: two lower-cost planes preserving physical open gap

lod3.cloth: two planes preserving large-scale occupancy value

lod.transition: animated cross-fade; visible pop is a critical render-review defect

lookdev.generation_brief: 4K macro lookdev sheet of an ordinary circa-2000 Japanese apartment aluminium sliding window seen from outside in midsummer daylight. Show two depth-separated clear glass leaves, an interior coated-aluminium curtain track, two dry woven off-white/beige curtain leaves with 55 mm gathered pleats and a naturally asymmetric opening, and a non-emissive dim room backing 180 mm behind glass. Include frontal, 35-degree oblique and 75-degree grazing views plus 100% crops. Sun/sky reflections must exist only on glass through real light transport; fabric must remain rough and dielectric with visible weave but no painted highlight. No disaster, damage, renovation or reconstruction cues.
render_checks: curtain geometry clearly behind glass rather than coplanar
glass reflection remains dominant over fabric specular
30-bay facade does not read as cloned window cards
cloth weave does not shimmer or become moire at distance
LOD transition does not visibly close/open the curtain gap
